questions.prompt: How are Prometheus alert rules delivered from an application charm to Prometheus in COS?
options: Packaged in the charm and transferred dynamically over the metrics-endpoint or alert-rules relation
Configured manually by editing the Prometheus charm source code
Through systemd timers executed by the controller
questions.answer: Packaged in the charm and transferred dynamically over the metrics-endpoint or alert-rules relation
questions.explanation: Modern charms package alert rules inside the charm and communicate them over Juju relations directly to Prometheus.

questions.prompt: What is the recommended architecture for monitoring multiple Juju workload models with COS?
options: Deploy COS in a central model and connect workload models using Cross-Model Relations (CMR)
Deploy a separate full COS stack inside every single workload model
Run Prometheus directly inside the Juju controller database container
Use cron jobs to rsync logs to a central NFS mount
questions.answer: Deploy COS in a central model and connect workload models using Cross-Model Relations (CMR)
questions.explanation: Hosting COS in a dedicated model (often on K8s) and consuming metrics/logs across workload models via Cross-Model Relations is the canonical architecture.

questions.prompt: Which component in COS provides distributed request tracing across microservices?
questions.explanation: Grafana Tempo provides distributed tracing for OTLP/OpenTelemetry traces.
